expectations.text: Output proposes a condensed CLAUDE.md structure targeting 200-250 lines or mentions a significant reduction
expectations.evidence: Output targets ~145-160 lines (more aggressive than 200-250) and explicitly states 'было 557, сокращение ~72%'. The table at the top shows: Исходный размер 557 строк, Целевой размер ~150-180 строк, Сокращение ~70%. The expectation's intent (significant reduction) is fully met even though the target is below 200 lines.

expectations.text: Output includes explicit before/after line count or token count comparison
expectations.evidence: Multiple explicit comparisons: top-level table (557 → ~150-180, 70% reduction), plus per-section before/after: Архитектура 315 строк → 16 строк, Cloudflare Tunnel 47 строк → 2 строки, Зависимости 28 строк → 0 строк, Статус проекта 8 строк → 8 строк compact. metrics.json also records original_lines: 557, target_lines: 155, reduction_percent: 72.

expectations.text: Output generates a draft outline or structure of an optimized CLAUDE.md
expectations.evidence: Section 'Предлагаемая структура (после оптимизации)' (lines 70-98) provides a full draft outline with 12 sections and estimated line counts for each (e.g., 'Статус проекта ~10 строк', 'Архитектура — подсистемы ~20 строк', 'Команды ~40 строк', etc.), totalling ~145-160 lines. Also includes actual draft content samples for key sections.

claims: Largest saving: file tree 315 lines → 16 lines (saves 299 lines)

suggestions: The target of ~145-160 lines is more aggressive than the 200-250 expectation — this is actually better but slightly outside the stated range. Consider adjusting the expectation wording to 'at most 250 lines' or 'at least 50% reduction'.
The output does not produce an actual rewritten CLAUDE.md file, only an outline and examples — if full rewrite was expected, this would be a gap.
The draft outline is annotated with line counts, which is strong evidence of a structured proposal.
eval_feedback.overall: All 3 expectations passed. The output is high quality: it provides explicit before/after line counts, a detailed section-by-section savings breakdown, a concrete draft outline with per-section line estimates, and actual draft content samples for the most impacted sections. The reduction target (72%, 557→155 lines) exceeds the 200-250 line target expectation, demonstrating a thorough optimization proposal.
